<a id="page-engage"></a>
# Engagement (feature layer)

The engagement layer: app events that the project's automations listen for (a popup after a lesson, a review prompt after the third order), and the `{usage}` counters they read. Open it when a UI fires an app event. Its words and actions are allowed only where the host enables the layer (see [levels.md](levels.md)).

<a id="engage-actions"></a>
## Actions

Written in an event as their type and fields by name, as on [events.md](events.md#events-actions).

<a id="action-emitEvent"></a>
### `emitEvent`: Emit event

Fires app event `event` with `props` (text values are expressions) on the app's event bus: the project's automations listening for it run (a popup after the third order), and the host app hears it (`codelessly.events`). The same bus a host fires with `codelessly.emit(name, props)`. JSON: `{"type": "emitEvent", "event": "onboarding_done", "props": {"plan": "${plan}"}}`.

Written `emitEvent event=… props=…`. Level 0.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event` | text | `""` | The app event's name (an expression). |
| `props` | JSON |  | Its properties; text values are expressions. |

## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).
